summary: Iteration 4 features verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 new pytests pass (image-proxy allow/deny, send-otp, verify-otp success+wrong, /me/bookings, /dealer/leads aggregates + city filter). Frontend: /cars renders REAL car photos via /api/image-proxy (Swift, Brezza, Baleno, Creta, Venue, i20, Nexon, Punch, Harrier, Curvv, Thar, XUV700, Scorpio-N, XUV3XO, Seltos, Carens, Fortuner visible). 11 cars without CAR_IMAGES entry correctly fall back to SVG silhouette (Sonet, Urban Cruiser Hyryder, Innova Hycross, Elevate, Amaze, City, etc.). Phone OTP login → /my-bookings flow works (3 bookings shown for 9876543210). Dealer page shows 4 KPI cards, ₹1.64 L commission, 14 leads, city filter works (Mumbai filter correctly filters rows).

minor.issue: Wikimedia returns HTTP 429 (rate-limit) on bursty fresh-visit loads (~75 simultaneous proxied requests from /cars). Once cached in-memory they serve fine, but first-time visits produce many 429s in console. Consider: (a) serve a persistent disk cache OR (b) add User-Agent with a contact URL (current is OK but could use token+email) OR (c) add a small concurrency semaphore / delay between fetches OR (d) return a fallback 1x1 transparent PNG on 429 so browser doesn't show broken image.
Still returns 200 instead of 201 Created (flagged iter-2, iter-3, still not fixed).
No pydantic validator on phone (accepts any string) — flagged iter-2, iter-3, still open.

Token is not signed/JWT — it's a plain UUID string stored in mongo. Acceptable for MVP but no server verifies it on /me/bookings (endpoint accepts phone as query param without auth). Any attacker can fetch any user's bookings given a phone. HIGH priority before prod.
No auth — public endpoint exposes PII (customer names, phones, cities). Intentional per MVP note, but add admin token before any external demo.

ui_bugs.issue: On fresh load, several car images show broken (429 rate-limit from Wikimedia through proxy). Network tab shows 19+ 429s per page load. Once-cached they work. Visually 18/75 imgs loaded on first paint in automation run.
Still shows '29+ CARS INDEXED' (should be 106+) — flagged iterations 2+3, still not fixed.
React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (flagged iteration 3, still present).

issues: Title uppercased via CSS (font-display uppercase) so DOM text reads 'EVERY LEAD. LIVE.' — matches design intent. No issue, just noting for test assertions.

action_items: HIGH: Protect /api/me/bookings — currently accepts raw phone query with no auth/token check. Validate the session token issued by /verify-otp and filter by the token→phone mapping from db.user_sessions.
HIGH: Protect /api/dealer/leads and /api/partners/leads behind an admin/dealer token (env-configurable).

MEDIUM: Mitigate Wikimedia 429 in /api/image-proxy — add persistent disk cache, reduce concurrency from client (lazy-load below-the-fold), serve 1×1 transparent PNG on 429 so broken-image icon doesn't show, or move to a self-hosted/CDN mirror for the 95 verified URLs.
LOW: Booking create should return 201 (still 200 after 3 iterations).
LOW: Add pydantic validator on BookingRequest.phone (10 digits, numeric).
LOW: Update Home hero '29+ CARS INDEXED' → '106+'.
LOW: Fix <span>-in-<option> hydration warning on Compare.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/me/bookings has NO authentication — it's a simple `GET /me/bookings?phone=X` that returns anyone's bookings. Whole point of OTP login is defeated. Must verify token from Authorization header or from user_sessions collection.
/api/auth/verify-otp stores the token, but nothing ever reads user_sessions to validate subsequent requests. Add a dependency like get_current_phone(token: str = Header(...)).

/api/image-proxy has a 500-item in-memory dict cache that is lost on each backend restart and not shared across pods. For a photo-heavy page with 75 URLs this is wasteful. Use disk/Redis cache or stream through a reverse proxy (Caddy/nginx).
server.py is now ~720 lines with image proxy + OTP + dealer + bookings + AI + partners. Split into routers/ before it grows (already flagged iter-3).
MyBookings.jsx imports formatINR but never uses it (dead import).
carImages.js is 95 hardcoded URLs; when a new car is added without an entry it silently falls back to silhouette — add a build-time lint or test to warn.
Login.jsx catches `catch {` without checking error.response?.status — any network blip shows 'Invalid OTP' or 'Could not send OTP' with no distinction.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (login, OTP, my-bookings, dealer, navbar, /cars dual CTAs all verified; image 429 rate-limit causes visible broken imgs on first visit)

rca_of_the_issue: Wikimedia 429s: upstream throttles ~75 parallel requests from the same backend IP within <1s. Browser fires proxy requests in parallel for every . The in-memory _IMAGE_CACHE helps after first successful hit but the first burst overflows Wikimedia's limits. Mitigation ranked by effort: (1) quickest — serve a tiny transparent PNG + Cache-Control=0 on 502/429 so the browser retries on next visit; (2) medium — add asyncio.Semaphore(8) around httpx.get; (3) best — persistent Redis cache with TTL 30 days.
